full_judgment: 23. It further appears that the suit land was wrongly recorded in the ROR khatian in the name of one Abdul Hakim and then Museb Ali Fakir (plaintiff No. 1) and Cherag Ali Fakir, predecessor-in-interest or plaintiff Nos. 2-4 filed Miscellaneous Case No. 12 of 1972 for correction of the record under section 143A of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950. The case was dismissed against which the petitioners filed Miscellaneous Appeal No. 202 of 1974 before the District Judge, Mymensingh and the appeal was allowed and the miscellaneous case was allowed and the name of the said Abdul Hakim was deleted and the record was corrected pursuant to the judgment passed in the miscellaneous appeal. All these facts prima facie show that it is the plaintiffs, who, in fact, had been managing the Mosque and the Mazar and running their day to day affairs and enjoying/appropriating the shirni selat offered therein.
